visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro phase: A female creator with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless top, appears in a small picture-in-picture window at the bottom right. The main screen shows a title card for 'THE MAN MAN' in red block letters against a light pink background. (2) Exploration phase: The scene shifts to a dimly lit low-poly 3D bedroom environment. A small character model crawls awkwardly under a bed and through the room. The lighting is dark with a focused blue spotlight effect around the player. The female creator reacts with wide eyes and animated facial expressions. (3) Action phase: The character model moves towards a figure lying on a bed and performs a stabbing motion. Large red pixelated blood effects splash across the screen. A second NPC enters and is chased. The creator continues her expressive reactions in the corner. (4) Result phase: A summary screen appears with a pink background and hearts, displaying 'YOU KILLED HIM!' and game statistics. A large, distorted 3D head of the game character is shown. The creator looks at the camera and gestures while talking.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Intro Phase: The audio opens with a high-arousal female greeting. A quirky, mid-tempo electronic BGM with steady synth hits and a light percussive beat starts immediately. (2) Gameplay Phase: The female speaker maintains a fast-paced, animated commentary. Short, muffled percussive thud SFX from the game character's crawling are audible. Pitch variability is high as she reacts to game obstacles. (3) Conflict Phase: Sharp impact SFX and a swelling of BGM intensity occur during the stabbing action. The speaker's vocal intensity increases to shouting. Sound design transitions are marked by digital UI chirps. (4) Outro Phase: The vocal volume stabilizes but remains energetic as she concludes her thoughts. The BGM continues until the track ends with a hard cut.

By combining expressive visual reactions with fast-paced, emotive audio commentary, the creator highlights the absurd mechanics of the game to engage her viewers.
